settings_form.title: Users & sign-up
settings_form.description: Sign-up rules, session and token lifetimes, sign-in protection, social sign-in and the demo accounts.

allow_signup.label: Allow self-service sign-up
allow_signup.help: Let visitors register their own account.

require_verification.label: Require email verification
require_verification.help: New accounts must confirm their email address before they can sign in.

signup_default_role.label: Default role for sign-ups
signup_default_role.help: Existing role given to accounts that register themselves. Blank: no role. The admin role is not allowed.

reset_password_token_lifetime_seconds.label: Password reset link lifetime (seconds)
reset_password_token_lifetime_seconds.help: How long a password reset link stays valid.

verification_token_lifetime_seconds.label: Email verification link lifetime (seconds)
verification_token_lifetime_seconds.help: How long an email verification link stays valid.

bearer_token_lifetime_seconds.label: Access token lifetime (seconds)
bearer_token_lifetime_seconds.help: How long an access token for mobile and API clients works before it must be refreshed.

refresh_token_lifetime_seconds.label: Refresh token lifetime (seconds)
refresh_token_lifetime_seconds.help: How long a refresh token can be used to get new access tokens.

refresh_token_family_max_age_days.label: Maximum sign-in age (days)
refresh_token_family_max_age_days.help: Longest a chain of refresh tokens may be renewed before the user has to sign in again.

cookie_name.label: Session cookie name
cookie_name.help: Name of the cookie that holds the sign-in session.

cookie_max_age_seconds.label: Session lifetime (seconds)
cookie_max_age_seconds.help: How long a normal sign-in session lasts.

remember_me_max_age_seconds.label: Keep-me-signed-in lifetime (seconds)
remember_me_max_age_seconds.help: How long a session lasts when the user ticks the keep-me-signed-in box. The sign-in page shows the matching number of days.

session_version_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Session check cache (seconds)
session_version_cache_ttl_seconds.help: How long a server reuses a session check before asking the database again. Lower values notice a revoked session sooner on other servers; 0 checks on every request.

cookie_samesite.label: Cookie SameSite policy
cookie_samesite.help: Whether the session cookie is sent with requests coming from other sites: lax, strict or none.

base_url.label: Account link base URL
base_url.help: Address that account emails such as verification and reset links point to. If blank, the host's public URL is used.

mail_template_dirs.label: Custom email template folders
mail_template_dirs.help: Absolute folders searched first for verification, reset and invitation email templates. Relative or missing paths are ignored.

login_rate_limit_failures.label: Failed sign-ins per source
login_rate_limit_failures.help: Failed attempts for one username from one IP address within the window before that source is throttled.

login_rate_limit_window_seconds.label: Sign-in attempt window (seconds)
login_rate_limit_window_seconds.help: Period over which failed sign-ins are counted.

login_rate_limit_cooldown_seconds.label: Lockout duration (seconds)
login_rate_limit_cooldown_seconds.help: How long an account stays locked after too many failed sign-ins.

login_lockout_account_failures.label: Failed sign-ins before account lockout
login_lockout_account_failures.help: Failed attempts from anywhere within the window that lock the account.

auth_rate_limit_attempts.label: Account action limit
auth_rate_limit_attempts.help: Attempts per IP address within the window for registering, forgotten passwords, accepting invitations and verification requests.

auth_rate_limit_window_seconds.label: Account action window (seconds)
auth_rate_limit_window_seconds.help: Period over which those attempts are counted.

demo_mode.label: Enable demo sign-in
demo_mode.help: Adds a one-click sign-in button for each demo account on the sign-in page. No password is sent to the browser.

demo_admin_email.label: Demo admin email
demo_admin_email.help: Email of the demo administrator account. Leave blank to offer only the user account.

demo_user_email.label: Demo user email
demo_user_email.help: Email of the demo regular-user account. Leave blank to offer only the admin account.

demo_admin_password.label: Demo admin password
demo_admin_password.help: Password for a new demo account; blank gives it a random one, so it is only reachable through its button. Clearing it later keeps the existing password. Set one only if you publish the credentials.

demo_user_password.label: Demo user password
demo_user_password.help: Password for a new demo account; blank gives it a random one, so it is only reachable through its button. Clearing it later keeps the existing password. Set one only if you publish the credentials.

demo_read_only.label: Read-only demo sessions
demo_read_only.help: Block every change made from a demo session. Turn off only if the database is disposable, since a writable admin demo is a public administrator.

oauth_google_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_google_client_id.help: Client ID from your Google OAuth app.

oauth_google_client_secret.label: Client secret
oauth_google_client_secret.help: Client secret from your Google OAuth app. It is hidden once saved.

oauth_github_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_github_client_id.help: Client ID from your GitHub OAuth app.

oauth_github_client_secret.label: Client secret
oauth_github_client_secret.help: Client secret from your GitHub OAuth app. It is hidden once saved.

oauth_oidc_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_oidc_client_id.help: Client ID registered with your OpenID Connect provider.

oauth_oidc_client_secret.label: Client secret
oauth_oidc_client_secret.help: Client secret for that client. It is hidden once saved.

oauth_oidc_discovery_url.label: Discovery URL
oauth_oidc_discovery_url.help: Address of the provider's discovery document. Works with Keycloak, Authentik, Auth0, Zitadel and similar.

oauth_oidc_display_name.label: Button label
oauth_oidc_display_name.help: Name shown on the sign-in button.

oauth_microsoft_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_microsoft_client_id.help: Application (client) ID from your Microsoft app registration.

oauth_microsoft_client_secret.label: Client secret
oauth_microsoft_client_secret.help: Client secret from your Microsoft app registration. It is hidden once saved.

oauth_microsoft_tenant.label: Tenant
oauth_microsoft_tenant.help: Use common for any account, organizations for work or school accounts only, or a directory ID to allow one organization.

oauth_microsoft_trust_tenant_upn.label: Trust member sign-in names as verified email
oauth_microsoft_trust_tenant_upn.help: Treat a member's sign-in name as a verified email so it links to an invited or verified local account. Only works when the tenant is a directory ID. Guests stay unverified.

oauth_microsoft_discovery_url.label: Discovery URL override
oauth_microsoft_discovery_url.help: For development and testing only: take Microsoft endpoints from a local provider. Ignored in other environments.

oauth_signup_providers.label: Providers that may create accounts
oauth_signup_providers.help: Providers whose users can create an account on first sign-in even when sign-up is off, if the provider confirmed their email. Choose from google, github, microsoft and oidc.

oauth_signup_default_role.label: Default role for these accounts
oauth_signup_default_role.help: Role given to accounts created this way. Blank: no role until an admin assigns one. The admin role is not allowed.

oauth_trusted_email_domains.label: Trusted email domains
oauth_trusted_email_domains.help: Email domains each provider may vouch for, for example microsoft: example.com. Exact domains only. Available for microsoft and oidc.

oauth_sync_profile.label: Update name on every sign-in
oauth_sync_profile.help: Refresh the account's full name from the provider each time the user signs in. The email is never changed.
